description: Defines the ContainerAdministrator class responsible for managing container instances and producers within the Thunder::ProcessContainers namespace.

classes.name: ContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing container creation, retrieval, and producer registration within the process containers framework.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ContainerAdministrator.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the container administrator with a given configuration string.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container of type T with provided arguments.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Retrieves a container by type and id, with search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its id.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all containers.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Registers a container producer for a specific container type.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a container producer for a specific container type.
